# Support

For bugs, use the Bug report issue form. For feature ideas, use the Feature request form.

Before opening a request:

- Check existing issues for the same problem.
- Include the affected screen or app, steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.
- Include device and browser details when relevant.
- Remove passwords, tokens, private URLs, and personal data from logs or screenshots.

General questions and discussions can be posted in GitHub Discussions if they are enabled for this repository.
